groups.label: Extraarticular / pole
groups.description: Patellar pole or extraarticular fracture patterns that may disrupt the extensor mechanism.

variants.label: Superior pole avulsion
variants.description: Avulsion involving the quadriceps tendon insertion.

variants.label: Inferior pole avulsion
variants.description: Distal pole fragment associated with patellar tendon attachment.

variants.label: Sleeve / marginal fragment
variants.description: Small marginal or sleeve-type extraarticular fragment.

treatments.label: Immobilization
treatments.main_indications: Intact extensor mechanism and minimal displacement.

treatments.label: Tension band fixation
treatments.main_indications: Displaced transverse or pole fracture with reconstructable fragments.

treatments.label: Suture / anchor repair
treatments.main_indications: Small distal pole fragment not suitable for screw or wire fixation.

groups.label: Partial articular / body
groups.description: Patellar body fracture with partial articular involvement.

variants.label: Vertical split
variants.description: Sagittal or vertical split with partial articular involvement.

variants.label: Osteochondral fragment
variants.description: Articular fragment with limited extraarticular extension.

variants.label: Marginal articular fragment
variants.description: Partial articular rim or facet fragment.

treatments.label: Lag screw fixation
treatments.main_indications: Large simple articular fragment allowing compression fixation.

treatments.label: Tension band construct
treatments.main_indications: Displaced body fracture requiring conversion of tensile forces into compression.

treatments.label: Intraoperative imaging reference
treatments.main_indications: Assessing reduction, implant position, and articular congruity.

groups.label: Complete articular / multifragmentary
groups.description: Complete articular or multifragmentary patellar fracture with extensor mechanism risk.

variants.label: Simple transverse
variants.description: Complete articular transverse pattern with two main fragments.

variants.label: Transverse with wedge
variants.description: Complete articular pattern with an additional wedge fragment.

variants.label: Multifragmentary
variants.description: Comminuted patellar fracture with multiple articular fragments.

treatments.label: Open reduction internal fixation
treatments.main_indications: Displaced reconstructable articular fracture with extensor mechanism disruption.

treatments.label: Partial patellectomy / tendon repair
treatments.main_indications: Nonreconstructable small pole fragment with salvageable remaining patella.

treatments.label: Patient examination
treatments.main_indications: Assessment of extensor mechanism integrity and associated knee injury.
